title: The Midnight Biryani Heist of Block C
dispute_text: Someone stole my biryani from the hostel refrigerator at midnight
setting: Block C Hostel Kitchen, University Campus, 2AM
summary: A container of precious chicken biryani, lovingly prepared and stored in the Block C communal refrigerator, was found missing at 2AM. Fingerprints on the fridge handle and conflicting witness testimonies point to a hungry suspect.

CCTV footage shows Arun near kitchen at midnight
Arun had no dinner that evening (motive)
Arun's room is adjacent to the kitchen (opportunity)

pre_generated_witnesses.alibi_claim: I was in the study room at midnight solving eigenvalue problems
pre_generated_witnesses.secret: He was actually in the kitchen getting water and saw Arun take the biryani
